verdict.rationale: Asynchronous human approval is a fair axis for an auth framework that markets 'Auth for AI agents', but no evidence documents CIBA or any per-transaction human-approval step for agents. The Device Authorization plugin (RFC 8628) is a login-time device approval flow, not approval of an agent's sensitive transaction, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. The 'agent delegation' tagline does not describe an approval gate either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
